summary: This paper (CRUSH) presents a credit-based resource sharing strategy for dynamically scheduled HLS. The authors' own code artifact is on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.14017399), not as a standalone GitHub repo. However, CRUSH has been integrated into the Dynamatic HLS compiler at github.com/EPFL-LAP/dynamatic, which is the pre-existing open-source HLS compiler that the paper builds on and extends. The Dynamatic repo contains Crush.cpp implementing the algorithm, and the paper body (abstract and conclusion) explicitly links to it. Jiahui Xu (first author) is an active committer to the repo. Benchmark designs used in the evaluation come from standard benchmark suites (Polybench), not separate repos.
